Company Overview

Focused on High-Potential
Deepwater Exploration

BluEnergies Ltd. is a publicly traded Canadian energy company (TSXV: BLU | OTCQX: BLUGF) dedicated to unlocking high-impact frontier oil and gas plays across the West African continental margin.

Rather than accumulating a scattered, capital-dilutive acreage portfolio, BluEnergies concentrates technical resources and balance sheet focus on the under-explored Harper Basin, offshore southern Liberia. Through Reconnaissance Licence RL-003, the company partners with global energy supermajor TotalEnergies to systematically de-risk multi-billion-barrel prospective resource targets across 8,924 km² of undrilled Cretaceous turbidite fan complexes.

FEATURED ASSET

Harper Basin,
Offshore Liberia

Reconnaissance Licence RL-003 encompasses 8,924 km² (approx. 2.2 million acres) across deepwater Blocks LB-26, LB-30, and LB-31 along the West African Transform Margin.

The concession is governed by a Joint Study and Assessment Agreement with operator TotalEnergies (65%) and BluEnergies (35% working interest), authorized by the Liberia Petroleum Regulatory Authority (LPRA). The current exploration licence term extends through June 30, 2027, with all technical expenditures fully eligible for recovery upon conversion to production sharing contracts.

EXPLORATION POTENTIAL

Cretaceous Basin Floor Fan Play

Advanced 3D seismic interpretation across Blocks LB-26, LB-30, and LB-31 has mapped multiple high-amplitude Cretaceous turbidite fan systems with significant prospective hydrocarbon potential.

Geological Mechanics &
Petroleum System

The Harper Basin represents a classic transform continental margin. Submarine canyons incised during the Mid-to-Late Cretaceous transported coarse clastic sands onto the deep ocean floor, depositing stacked turbidite fan lobes with high reservoir quality.

Rich Cenomanian-Turonian marine organic-rich shales act as prime oil-prone source kitchens, while subsequent thick pelagic clay blankets form impermeable top and lateral seals. Seismic amplitude anomalies and amplitude-versus-offset (AVO) signatures indicate the presence of hydrocarbon-bearing porous sandstone reservoirs.

Turbidite sand (reservoir)
Shale (source rock)
Clay (seal)

Regulatory Disclosure regarding Exploration Assets: Prospective resources are estimated quantities of petroleum that may potentially be recovered by the application of future development projects. These prospective resources are undiscovered and have both an associated risk of discovery and a risk of development. There is no certainty that any portion of the resources will be discovered or, if discovered, will be commercially viable. BluEnergies Ltd. has not yet drilled an exploration well or established commercial production in Reconnaissance Licence RL-003.

Strategic Partnership

Joint Exploration with TotalEnergies

In January 2026, BluEnergies formalized a Joint Study and Assessment Agreement (JSAA) with TotalEnergies for Reconnaissance Licence RL-003, offshore Liberia.

Under the agreement, TotalEnergies holds a 65% operating interest and BluEnergies holds a 35% participating interest. This collaboration pairs BluEnergies' early basin mover advantage with the operational scale, engineering pedigree, and capital strength of one of the world's leading deepwater operators.

Explore partnership details
Global Deepwater Operating Leadership

TotalEnergies is a global energy supermajor with world-leading deepwater exploration and development expertise, having drilled landmark discoveries in West Africa, Brazil, and Suriname.

Technical Evaluation & Data Synergy

The partnership combines TotalEnergies’ proprietary geoscience capabilities with BluEnergies’ local basin capture intelligence to accelerate geological, geophysical, and geochemical studies.

Commercial Framework & Cost Recovery

The Joint Study and Assessment Agreement (JSAA) establishes an efficient capital structure where 100% of approved reconnaissance expenditures qualify for cost recovery under subsequent production contracts.

Direct Pathway to Drilling Exploration Wells

The joint programme systematically de-risks candidate well locations, preparing the consortium to mature the licence into definitive drilling targets ahead of the June 30, 2027 milestone.

Exploration Progression

Exploration Work Programme

BluEnergies and operating partner TotalEnergies are actively executing a multi-disciplinary technical exploration programme across Reconnaissance Licence RL-003.

01

TGS 3D Seismic Reprocessing

In Progress (Announced July 2026)
Contractor:TGS ASA
Scope:6,167 km² of 3D Seismic Data

Application of advanced broadband depth migration and high-fidelity velocity modelling to sharpen subsurface structural imaging and resolve stratigraphic boundaries across Cretaceous fan systems.

02

Multibeam Bathymetric Seafloor Survey

In Progress (Announced July 2026)
Contractor:GeoPartners / TDI-Brooks (R/V GYRE)
Scope:4,045 km² High-Resolution MBES

Executing a comprehensive seafloor bathymetric survey to map seabed topography, identify pockmarks and fault scarps, and detect potential sea-bottom hydrocarbon seepage features.

03

Seabed Geochemical Coring & Heat-Flow

In Progress
Contractor:TDI-Brooks International
Scope:Piston Coring & Geothermal Probes

Acquiring physical seabed piston cores for hydrocarbon geochemical fingerprinting combined with in-situ heat-flow measurements to calibrate basin thermal maturity and migration models.

04

Prospect Delineation & Well Targeting

Planned Next Stage (2026–2027)
Contractor:TotalEnergies & BluEnergies G&G Consortium
Scope:Blocks LB-26, LB-30, LB-31

Full synthesis of reprocessed 3D seismic, AVO amplitude anomalies, and geochemical seepage data to rank drillable prospects and mature candidates for an exploration drilling campaign.

Investor Relations

Capital Structure &
Investor Proposition

BluEnergies provides institutional and retail investors with leveraged exposure to frontier deepwater exploration in one of Africa's few remaining undrilled Cretaceous fan plays.

With C$20.7 million in growth capital raised through an oversubscribed non-brokered private placement in July 2026, the company is fully funded to execute its share of the active 3D reprocessing and seabed survey programmes alongside operating partner TotalEnergies.

Leadership & Governance

Experienced Exploration Leadership

Guided by an experienced board and technical executive team with over a century of combined global hydrocarbon exploration and capital markets leadership.

Meet full leadership
CS

Craig Steinke

Chief Executive Officer & Director

Craig Steinke is the Chief Executive Officer and a Director of BluEnergies Ltd. A co-founder of the company, he has more than 30 years of international experience identifying, evaluating, structuring, and financing natural resource and energy exploration ventures across emerging and frontier basins worldwide. Under his leadership, BluEnergies identified and captured the Harper Basin deepwater play and negotiated the farm-in partnership with TotalEnergies.

EI

Enzo Insalaco

Executive Vice-President and General Counsel

Executive Vice-President and General Counsel of BluEnergies Ltd. Brings extensive international legal, regulatory, and commercial transaction experience within the upstream oil and gas sector across Africa and global frontier jurisdictions.

SL

Sergio Laura

Vice President of Exploration

Sergio Laura is a petroleum geologist with over 40 years of international hydrocarbon exploration and reservoir geology experience. Formerly with major international operators including Eni/Agip, he has led technical evaluations, seismic interpretation programmes, and exploration campaigns across West Africa, North Africa, and the Mediterranean.

CL

Carol Law

Independent Director

Carol Law brings over 40 years of technical, managerial, and commercial leadership in the international petroleum exploration industry. She previously held senior exploration and asset management positions with major independent and international oil companies including Amoco, BP, and Anadarko Petroleum Corporation.
